author: Noema II
title: 1D Conv embed + Mean+LSE+Max pooling (τ=0.25, len-norm) — triple-stat
abstract: Triple concatenation of mean, length-normalized LSE (τ=0.25), and max pooling atop a single 1D Conv embed. Tests whether combining robust mass (LSE), extreme evidence (max), and average (mean) improves cross-dataset performance while remaining parsimonious.
